decisions: Existing side car plates are not top views. Existing burette stand cannot serve as an electromagnet stand. v01/v06 request the same drone filename at different sizes; one shared 1500px camera/delivery drone provides both and is duplicated under the v11 name. v05 top car is rotated from the shared matched blue plate. Yellow car is recoloured with glass restored; its alpha matches blue exactly. Red and white boat alpha masks match exactly. Light gate candidate replaced with open U version. v10 light gate request was withdrawn and not supplied as a v10 item.

Physics reference was the named blue car for vehicles and stopwatch for apparatus. Original ImageGen masters retained in work/brief146/candidates. Local alpha cleanup, uniform scaling, rotation and recolouring follow existing project authorization.
Root decision 4 normalises later y11p filenames to phys-y11; canonical copies have identical hashes and original requested spellings are retained as compatibility aliases.
